bull.b: The sharp 2025 revenue acceleration and strong net margin demonstrate that argenx has converted product adoption into substantial earnings power. If commercial expansion continues, this profitability can fund clinical development and commercialization internally while strengthening the company’s competitive position.

Minimal leverage and a large equity and asset base give argenx considerable financial flexibility. This supports continued investment in research, regulatory programs and global launches without the balance-sheet pressure that can constrain biotechnology companies during development or market expansion.

bull.t: Commercial leadership and expanding immunology platform
bull.b: VYVGART’s sustained sales growth, broad approval across gMG serotypes and expanding patient uptake provide a durable commercial foundation. The established franchise can support geographic and label expansion while creating a platform for additional pipeline launches in adjacent immune-mediated diseases.

bear.b: Although cash generation improved materially in 2025, the multiyear history of negative operating and free cash flow shows that earnings have not yet translated consistently into cash. Persistent conversion gaps could limit internally funded investment and make results more dependent on sustained commercial execution.

bear.t: Pipeline attrition and clinical development uncertainty
bear.b: Stopping UNITY for futility removes a late-stage development opportunity and illustrates the clinical risk within argenx’s broader pipeline. Future value creation therefore depends on successful readouts and regulatory progress across other programs, where trial outcomes and indication breadth remain uncertain.

bear.t: High operating investment and reimbursement barriers
bear.b: Heavy R&D and selling investment can pressure margins if revenue growth moderates, while payer requirements may slow earlier-line adoption in CIDP. Together, these factors could delay returns on commercialization spending and require continued execution to convert the pipeline into durable earnings.
